fields.name: eventID
fields.events: All events unless noted
fields.definition: Unique ID assigned to this local event record.

fields.zeroMeaning: Not a numeric measure.
fields.notes: Useful for identifying duplicate exported records; not a student ID.
fields.caution: Used for troubleshooting; does not establish learning or identity.

fields.zeroMeaning: May be an unused default outside the stated events/mode; within those events, zero is the recorded value.

fields.caution: Interpret only for the stated events and mode; defaults are not evidence of performance.

fields.name: telemetryVersion
